title: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 4 (Substitute Payment for Amounts Used Directly)
When the Minister of Foreign Affairs grants approval under Article 3, the Minister shall require the disbursing officer under his or her jurisdiction to deduct, from funds to be disbursed to the relevant diplomatic mission, an amount corresponding to the amount approved for direct use, and to pay that amount into the National Treasury or deposit it under the relevant expenditure budget item. [Amended on March 23, 2013.]
